scope: Six new 100-epoch BDD bases: nano and large for seeds404/505/606. CPU reload only, without training, validation inference or checkpoint repair.
entry_gate: Require COMPLETE.json before reading any per-run state; require exact frozen protocol, source manifests and base preflight bindings. Never assert that the old original coordinator must still be alive or that its expected historical cache-failure marker must be absent.
checks: Exact source/data/config bindings and effective shared training settings; 100 ordered results rows and epoch records.
Integer cumulative attempted=applied+skipped counts, monotonicity and positive actual applications per epoch; final COMPLETE, final epoch and raw sidecar counts agree.
Native base EMA update count equals attempted steps, including AMP-skipped attempts; it is not substituted for actual applications.
Finite raw model, EMA, checkpoint, optimizer, scaler and scheduler; saved RNG components present. This presence check is not a claim of exact base interruption replay.
Raw and EMA parameters are FP32; released checkpoint equals raw final EMA at the checkpoint's saved precision; raw parameters changed and fixed DFL remains unchanged.

All six proofs required for aggregate gate; initial, raw-final and EMA parameter digests differ between each same-architecture pair, and both sampled input hashes differ across every one of the100 epochs.

Every input bound by SHA256 is checked again after reading; cached passed proofs are reused only if audit source, protocol and all bound evidence still match. Existing proof files are never overwritten.
validation: 25 fabricated CPU known-answer/rejection cases passed. These cover valid skip-aware counts and saved-precision binding, corrupt counts/config/bytes/epochs/inputs, nonfinite state, unchanged or wrong-precision raw parameters, EMA mismatch, DFL drift, missing RNG, input mutation and incomplete/duplicate aggregate rosters.
status_limit: Only audit software readiness has been verified. No completed new research base has yet been audited; the actual six-base gate remains pending. This audit does not prove every training input or gradient was finite and does not reconstruct missing historical base counters.
downstream_gate: Both the completed-six-base audit and the separate continuation observational-parity/interruption-replay preflight must pass before any new continuation training starts.
